cases.situation: I'm Marcus Lee, renting 2217 N Oakley Ave, Unit 3B in Chicago; section 14 of my lease says 60 days' written notice. I want to be out Dec 31. The property manager is Denise at a small management company.
cases.reply:
Dear Denise,
I'm writing to give notice that I will be vacating 2217 N Oakley Ave, Unit 3B, with my tenancy ending on 31 December 2026, in line with the 60-day written notice requirement in section 14 of my lease. I'll pay December's rent as usual and return all keys on the 31st. Could we schedule the move-out inspection for that afternoon? Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Thank you for making my time here so easy.
Marcus Lee
cases.note: Send it by 1 November at the latest to meet the 60 days; check whether the lease wants email, letter or both.

cases.situation: Je suis propriétaire d'un T2 à Nantes, le bail se termine le 31 mai 2027 et ma fille va y habiter. Je veux prévenir les locataires, Julien et Sarah, avant d'envoyer la lettre recommandée, et leur proposer une attestation de bon locataire et de la souplesse s'ils trouvent plus tôt.
cases.reply: Bonjour Julien et Sarah, je voulais vous prévenir personnellement avant le courrier officiel : je ne renouvellerai pas votre bail qui se termine le 31 mai 2027, car ma fille va venir habiter l'appartement. Vous recevrez le congé par lettre recommandée cette semaine, dans le délai de préavis prévu pour votre bail. Je sais qu'un déménagement est un vrai bouleversement, et je vous ferai volontiers une attestation de bon locataire. Si vous trouvez un logement plus tôt, dites-le-moi et on s'arrangera sur les dates.
cases.note: Ce message prévient, il ne remplace pas le congé officiel. Vérifiez le délai et la forme du congé auprès de l'ADIL avant l'envoi, car ils dépendent du type de bail.

cases.situation: 在上海租房，合同到明年3月，公司把我调去深圳，11月底就得走。房东是位王阿姨，合同写提前退租押金不退。我愿意帮她找下一位租客、配合带看，房租交到新租客入住为止。想跟她商量一下。
cases.reply: 王阿姨您好，公司把我调到深圳工作，所以想跟您商量能不能在11月30日提前退租。我可以帮您找下一位租客，配合带看，房租一直交到新租客入住为止。押金的事也想跟您商量一个两边都合适的办法，这周六上午方便通个电话吗？
cases.note: 提前退租是请求不是通知：先把对方的损失补上，再谈押金。谈妥的内容一定要落到书面。

cases.situation: I emailed my landlord Mr Okoye yesterday giving a month's notice to leave my flat at 7 Cotham Road, Flat 3, Bristol, on 28 October. He says it's invalid because it's a rolling tenancy and notice has to end on the last day of a rent period. Rent is due on the 15th. I think he's right.
cases.reply: Hi Mr Okoye, thanks for pointing that out. You're right that the notice should end on the last day of a rent period. Please treat this email as my notice to leave 7 Cotham Road, Flat 3, with the tenancy ending on Saturday 14 November 2026. I'll pay the rent due on 15 October as usual and return all keys on the 14th. Could you confirm in writing that you've received this?
cases.note: When they're right about the rule, re-serve correctly straight away instead of arguing. Before re-serving, check the current minimum notice for your tenancy type with a local tenant advice service, since the rules can change and may require more than a month.

cases.situation: I'm Maya Collins. Three of us rent 42 Linden Street on a joint lease through Parkside Lettings (property manager Owen). Tomás Ruiz is moving to Madrid at the end of November; Aoife Byrne and I want to stay, and our friend Hana Mori wants his room from 1 December and can send references and ID this week.
cases.reply: Hi Owen, I'm writing on behalf of the tenants at 42 Linden Street. Tomás Ruiz is moving out at the end of November, and Aoife Byrne and I would like to stay on. Could we replace Tomás on the lease with a new tenant, Hana Mori, from Tuesday 1 December 2026? She can send her references and ID this week for your checks. Please let us know what paperwork you need, and whether Tomás should also give notice separately. Could you confirm the next steps in writing? Thanks, Maya Collins
cases.note: Changing a joint tenancy is a request, not a notice. Get the new arrangement confirmed in writing before Tomás hands back his keys, since one tenant's notice can end the whole tenancy in some places.

cases.situation: Ich bin Jonas Weber und wohne zur Miete in der Karl-Heine-Straße 48, 2. OG links, 04229 Leipzig, unbefristeter Vertrag, gesetzliche Kündigungsfrist drei Monate. Für einen neuen Job in Hamburg will ich zum 31. Dezember raus; der unterschriebene Brief geht heute per Einschreiben an Frau Brandt von Mahler Immobilien. Besichtigungen gehen werktags ab 17 Uhr, Übergabe am liebsten Montag, 28. Dezember.
cases.reply:
Sehr geehrte Frau Brandt,
hiermit kündige ich das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Karl-Heine-Straße 48, 2. OG links, 04229 Leipzig, fristgerecht zum 31. Dezember 2026, gemäß der gesetzlichen Kündigungsfrist von drei Monaten. Das unterschriebene Original geht Ihnen heute per Einschreiben zu. Für Besichtigungen mit Nachmietern bin ich werktags ab 17 Uhr flexibel. Für die Übergabe mit Zählerablesung schlage ich Montag, den 28. Dezember, vor. Bitte bestätigen Sie mir den Eingang der Kündigung schriftlich.
Vielen Dank für die gute Zusammenarbeit.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Jonas Weber
cases.note: Die E-Mail ist nur die Vorabinfo: Maßgeblich ist meist der unterschriebene Brief, und er muss rechtzeitig ankommen, damit der 31. Dezember gilt. Frist und Zugang im Mietvertrag prüfen oder beim Mieterverein nachfragen.

cases.situation: I asked my landlord Greg if I could end my lease on Nov 30 instead of March 31 because I'm moving to Denver for work. He replied 'A lease is a lease, you owe rent through March.' Rent is $1,850. I don't want a fight. I'd find a replacement tenant, keep paying rent until they move in, and handle the listing and showings.
cases.reply: Hi Greg, I understand you'd rather keep the lease as it is, and I'm not asking you to lose money on the unit. Would you agree to release me from the lease once I find a replacement tenant who passes your usual checks? I'd keep paying the $1,850 rent until they move in, handle the listing and show the apartment around your schedule. If that works for you, I'm happy to put it in writing this week.
cases.note: After a no to leaving early, ask what would make it work; a vetted replacement answers his real worry. Get any deal in writing, and check your state's rules on a landlord's duty to re-let.

cases.situation: I rent my spare room to a lodger, Kofi, who's been with us 18 months, rent paid monthly on the 1st. My mum is moving in with us so I need the room back. Our agreement says one month's notice; I want to give him more and be kind about it: he's been great to share the house with and I'll gladly be his reference. We're in the UK.
cases.reply: Hi Kofi, I'd like to talk this through with you in person too, but here is the notice in writing. My mum is moving in with us, so I need the spare room back, and I'm ending our lodging agreement on Monday 30 November. That's two months rather than the one month in our agreement, to give you proper time to find somewhere. Your rent stays as it is until then, and we can agree a time for the handover nearer the date. I'm very happy to be a reference, and you've been a great person to share the house with. Could you confirm you've received this?
cases.note: A lodger in your home still gets exact dates in writing; giving more than the minimum notice and a reference is what keeps it kind.

cases.situation: Soy Lucía Ortega y vivo de alquiler en la calle Embajadores 112, 3.º B, en Madrid, desde marzo de 2025, con un propietario particular, don Alfonso. La cláusula 4 del contrato pide 30 días de preaviso por escrito. Me mudo a Valencia por trabajo, quiero dejar el piso el 30 de noviembre y le mandaré también un burofax.
cases.reply:
Estimado don Alfonso:
Le comunico que dejaré la vivienda de la calle Embajadores 112, 3.º B, y que el contrato terminará el 30 de noviembre de 2026, conforme al preaviso de 30 días de la cláusula 4. Le envío también este aviso por burofax para que quede constancia. Pagaré el alquiler de noviembre como siempre, y le propongo hacer la revisión del piso, la lectura de contadores y la entrega de llaves el lunes 30 a las 11:00. ¿Me podría confirmar por escrito que ha recibido este aviso?
Gracias por este año y medio, ha sido un placer.
Lucía Ortega
cases.note: Fecha exacta, cláusula y constancia por escrito primero; la amabilidad va al final. Si el contrato prevé una indemnización por salida anticipada, revísala antes de enviar.

cases.situation: 我在杭州有套两居室出租，租客小林住了三年，房租每次都按时交。合同12月31日到期，约定到期前一个月通知。我儿子明年结婚要住这里，不打算续租了。想先微信跟他说，再寄书面通知。我愿意按实际住的天数收租、交房当天退押金，也愿意给他写证明。
cases.reply: 小林你好，跟你说件事：我儿子明年结婚要住这套房，所以12月31日合同到期后就不续租了。合同约定提前一个月通知，我想早点告诉你，好让你有足够时间找房，正式的书面通知这周寄给你。如果你找到房子想提前搬，跟我说一声，日期一起商量，房租按实际住的天数算。交房那天我们一起验房、抄水电燃气表，押金当场退。这三年你一直按时交租，新房东需要证明的话我随时帮你写。收到麻烦回我一下。
cases.note: 房东不续租：到期日写清楚、理由一句、提前量多于合同要求，再把验房、退押金和推荐这些实际帮助说明白，并请对方确认收到。

cases.situation: I'm Sam Nguyen, renting 3/41 Albert Street, Brunswick, Melbourne, on a periodic agreement that says 28 days' written notice. We want to leave Nov 30. I work night shifts and we have a 3-month-old, so I also want to ask the agent, Priya at Northside Realty, to keep viewings to Tuesdays and Saturdays, 11am to 1pm.
cases.reply:
Dear Priya,
I'm writing to give notice that we will vacate 3/41 Albert Street, Brunswick, on Monday 30 November, in line with the 28 days' written notice in our rental agreement. Rent will be paid through to the 30th, and we'll hand back all keys at the final inspection that day if that suits. One request about viewings: I work night shifts and we have a three-month-old, so could they be kept to Tuesdays and Saturdays between 11am and 1pm, with the usual notice? We'll have the place tidy for them. Please confirm you've received this notice. Thanks for your help while we've been here.
Sam Nguyen
cases.note: The notice stands on its own in the first sentence; the viewing times are a separate request, so a no on those doesn't muddy the notice.

cases.situation: 山田健太です。東京のメゾン中野302号室を借りていて、契約書第12条では解約は1ヶ月前までに書面で通知することになっています。転勤で11月30日に退去したいです。管理会社はさくら不動産の佐藤さんで、まずメールで連絡して所定の解約通知書を送ってもらいたいです。
cases.reply:
さくら不動産 佐藤様
いつもお世話になっております。メゾン中野302号室の山田健太です。転勤のため、賃貸借契約を2026年11月30日（月）をもって解約したく、ご連絡いたしました。契約書第12条の「1ヶ月前までに書面で通知」に沿って手続きしたいので、所定の解約通知書をお送りいただけますでしょうか。届き次第記入し、今週中に返送いたします。退去立会いは11月30日の午前中を希望しております。本メールを受け取られた旨、ご返信いただけますと幸いです。
これまで大変お世話になりました。
山田健太
cases.note: メールは事前連絡。契約書が書面を求めているなら、解約通知書が期限までに届いて初めて有効になるので、控えも残しておく。

cases.situation: I'm Daniel Ortiz. My lease for 1840 Riverside Dr, Apt 2214 in Austin ends Dec 31, and section 3 says it auto-renews month-to-month at $150 more unless I give written notice at least 60 days before. I submitted the notice-to-vacate form in the resident portal today and also want to email Tasha, the leasing manager at Cedar Point Residential. My forwarding address will be 522 Maple Lane, Round Rock, TX 78664.
cases.reply:
Hi Tasha,
I'm writing to give notice that I will not renew my lease for 1840 Riverside Dr, Apt 2214, and will vacate on Thursday 31 December 2026, the end date of the current lease. This meets the 60-day written notice in section 3 of the lease, and I've also submitted the notice-to-vacate form in the resident portal today, so please don't convert the lease to month-to-month. I'll pay December's rent as usual and would like to book the move-out inspection for the afternoon of the 31st. My forwarding address for the deposit is 522 Maple Lane, Round Rock, TX 78664. Could you confirm in writing that you've received this notice?
Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz
cases.note: With an auto-renewal clause, say 'will not renew' in the first line, serve it every way the lease allows, and screenshot the portal submission.

cases.situation: I'm Ana Duarte and I run Rise & Crumb Bakery in Unit 7, Harbor Plaza. Section 22 of my 5-year commercial lease says it renews for another 5 years after January 31, 2027 unless I give 90 days' written notice by certified mail. We're moving to a bigger space. The landlord is Harbor Plaza LLC; the property manager is Glen Morris.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr Morris,
I'm writing to give notice that Rise & Crumb Bakery will not renew its lease for Unit 7, Harbor Plaza, and will vacate at the end of the current term on Sunday 31 January 2027. This is the 90 days' written notice required under section 22 of the lease, and a signed copy is going to you today by certified mail. Rent will be paid through January, and we'll return the unit in the condition the lease requires. Could we schedule a walkthrough in mid-January to agree on anything that needs doing before we leave? Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Thank you for five good years at Harbor Plaza.
Ana Duarte, Owner
cases.note: With a long auto-renewal on a commercial lease, serve notice exactly as the lease says, keep the mail receipt, and have someone check what the lease requires at hand-back.

cases.situation: My dad, Robert Mackay, died on September 18. He rented 14 Hyndland Road, Flat 1/2 in Glasgow from a private landlord, Mrs Duncan, for 11 years. I'm Fiona, his executor, and want the flat cleared and the keys back by 31 October, but I don't know what notice applies.
cases.reply:
Dear Mrs Duncan,
I'm sorry to tell you that my father, Robert Mackay, died on 18 September. As the executor of his estate, I'm writing to give notice to end his tenancy at 14 Hyndland Road, Flat 1/2. Could you let me know the notice period and end date you'll be working from, and whether you need a copy of the death certificate or anything else from me? I'm aiming to have the flat cleared and the keys back to you by Saturday 31 October, and I'm happy to do a check-out inspection with you that day. Please confirm in writing that you've received this.
Thank you for being his landlord all these years.
Yours sincerely,
Fiona Mackay
cases.note: Rules on ending a tenancy after a death vary by place and tenancy type; check with a local advice service before relying on a date.

cases.situation: I'm a landlord. My tenant Bea texted me on Monday Sept 28 that she's moving out on Oct 17. Our lease, clause 9, requires 30 days' written notice ending on the last day of a month, and rent is due on the 1st. I want to be clear about the dates without being harsh. I'm happy to start viewings now, and if a new tenant moves in earlier she only pays until the day before.
cases.reply: Hi Bea, thanks for letting me know, and good luck with the move. Under clause 9 of our lease, notice needs to be 30 days in writing and end on the last day of a month, so the earliest your tenancy can end is Saturday 31 October, with October's rent due on the 1st as usual. If a new tenant can move in before then, you'd only pay up to the day before they start, and I'm happy to begin viewings straight away. Could you email me to confirm 31 October as your end date, so we can book the check-out for that day?
cases.note: Landlord receiving short notice: the correct date with the clause, a way to cut her cost, and written confirmation. Check local rules before relying on the clause.

cases.situation: I'm Jenna Park, renting 3318 SE Taylor St, Apt 4 in Portland from Mr Hale on a month-to-month agreement that says 30 days' written notice. He's ignored my requests to fix the heating for six weeks and I've had enough, so I'm leaving on November 30. I'm furious, but I want the notice clean and my deposit back.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr Hale,
I'm writing to give notice that I will be leaving 3318 SE Taylor St, Apt 4, with my tenancy ending on Monday 30 November 2026, in line with the 30 days' written notice in our month-to-month agreement. I'll pay November's rent as usual and return all keys on the 30th. Could we arrange a move-out inspection that afternoon? I'll send my forwarding address for the deposit separately. Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Kind regards,
Jenna Park
cases.note: Keep the heating complaint in its own message: a notice that doubles as a grievance invites an argument about the grievance. Check how the agreement says notice must be served.

cases.situation: I'm Chloe. I rent a flat at 14 Carlton Road from my friend's parents, Mr and Mrs Adeyemi, with no written lease; in 2024 we agreed by text that rent is £850 on the 1st and either side gives a month's notice. I'm moving in with my partner and want to leave on 30 November, and I want to do it properly in writing. I'm happy to fit around any viewings.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr and Mrs Adeyemi,
I'm writing to give notice that I'll be moving out of 14 Carlton Road, with my tenancy ending on Monday 30 November 2026. That's more than the month's notice we agreed by text in 2024, and I'll pay November's rent of £850 on the 1st as usual. I'm happy to fit around any viewings, and I'd like to do a walk-through and hand back the keys on the 30th at a time that suits you. Could you reply to confirm you've received this? Thank you both for renting to me.
Best wishes,
Chloe
cases.note: With no written lease, check local rules on notice before relying on the text agreement, and keep a copy of this.

cases.situation: Sou a Mariana. Minha mãe, Lúcia Ferreira, de 82 anos, vai morar numa casa de repouso e precisa entregar o apartamento 51 da Rua das Palmeiras, 240, em Campinas, onde mora de aluguel há 15 anos. A cláusula 11 do contrato pede 30 dias de aviso por escrito e ela quer sair em 30 de novembro. Tenho procuração dela e vou escrever para o Sr. Ricardo, da imobiliária.
cases.reply:
Prezado Sr. Ricardo,
Escrevo em nome da minha mãe, Lúcia Ferreira, locatária do apartamento 51 da Rua das Palmeiras, 240, em Campinas, para comunicar a desocupação do imóvel e o encerramento da locação em 30 de novembro de 2026, conforme o aviso de 30 dias por escrito previsto na cláusula 11 do contrato. Ela vai se mudar para uma casa de repouso, e eu cuido da entrega com a procuração dela, que segue em anexo. O aluguel de novembro será pago normalmente, e gostaria de agendar a vistoria e a entrega das chaves para o dia 30. Pode me confirmar por escrito o recebimento deste aviso?
Obrigada por esses 15 anos de locação.
Atenciosamente,
Mariana Ferreira
cases.note: Confirme com a imobiliária se a procuração cobre a rescisão e em que forma o aviso precisa ser entregue, e guarde uma cópia.

cases.situation: 我在北京整租了一套两居，是跟房东签合同的主租人，合同2027年1月15日到期。次卧转租给了室友阿杰，他的押金3000在我这儿，我们当初约定谁要走提前一个月说。我明年1月回成都工作，不续租了，想在微信上正式通知他。
cases.reply: 阿杰，跟你正式说一下：我明年1月回成都工作，跟房东的合同1月15日到期后就不续了，所以你次卧的转租也到2027年1月15日结束。咱们约定的是提前一个月说，我现在就告诉你，是想让你多点时间找房。你的3000押金，1月15日交房验完没问题，当天就退给你。收到回我一声，找房需要帮忙随时说。
cases.note: 结束日期跟着主合同走；他想不想跟房东直接续签，让他自己去问，别替房东答应。

cases.situation: On September 1 I emailed my landlord Martin notice that I'd leave my flat at 5 Hollis Street on October 31. Yesterday the job move to Leeds fell through and I'd like to stay. Rent is £975, I've paid on time for three years, and as far as I know nobody has viewed the flat yet.
cases.reply: Hi Martin, I'd like to ask whether I could withdraw the notice I emailed on 1 September to leave 5 Hollis Street on 31 October. The job move behind it fell through yesterday, and I'd be glad to stay on at £975 on the same terms. I know you may already have plans for the flat, and if so I'll leave on 31 October as given. Could you let me know by Friday 9 October, and if it's a yes, confirm it in writing? Thanks for three easy years.
cases.note: Withdrawing notice is a request: treat the original date as still standing until he agrees in writing.

cases.situation: I'm Ellie Shaw. On 15 September my landlord, Mrs Kaur, wrote that she's selling Flat 2, 9 Elm Terrace and won't renew my tenancy when it ends on 31 January 2027; her letter says I can leave earlier by giving a month's written notice. I've found a new flat from 1 December, so I want to leave on 30 November. Rent is £1,050, due on the 1st.
cases.reply:
Dear Mrs Kaur,
Thank you for your letter of 15 September about not renewing my tenancy at Flat 2, 9 Elm Terrace. I've found a new flat, so, as your letter allows, I'm giving a month's written notice to end my tenancy on Monday 30 November 2026 instead of 31 January 2027. I'll pay November's rent of £1,050 on the 1st as usual. Could we book the check-out inspection and key handover for the 30th? Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice and that no rent is due after 30 November.
Kind regards,
Ellie Shaw
cases.note: Leaving early after a landlord's notice: rely on what her letter or the lease actually says, and if it's silent, check local rules before assuming rent stops.

cases.situation: 我在成都有套一居室租给小陈，合同到2027年6月30日，合同里没写房东可以提前收回。我明年调回成都工作，想自己住，想跟她商量能不能2027年2月28日退租；如果她同意，我免她2月的房租，再出1000元搬家费。
cases.reply: 小陈你好，想跟你商量件事：我明年调回成都工作，想自己住这套房，所以想问问你能不能在2027年2月28日退租，比合同的6月30日早四个月。这是跟你商量，不是通知，合同里没有这一条，你不同意的话我们就照原合同到6月30日。如果你愿意，2月的房租我就不收了，另外出1000元搬家费；现在提前说，也是想给你留足找房的时间。你慢慢考虑，商量好了我们把新的退租日期写进书面补充协议，双方签字。
cases.note: 房东提前收房是请求不是通知；能否单方面收回要看合同和当地规定，拿不准先咨询当地住房部门。

cases.situation: I'm Dana. I rent Apt 12, 9 Alder Court from Ms Ortega on a lease that runs to 31 March 2027. My ex-partner, who doesn't live here, has turned up at my door three times since I ended things in August, and I got a protective order on 22 September. I've found somewhere he doesn't know about and want to leave on 31 October; I'll pay October's rent, and I don't want my new address shared with anyone.
cases.reply:
Dear Ms Ortega,
I'm writing to ask to end my tenancy at Apt 12, 9 Alder Court early, on Saturday 31 October 2026, rather than when the lease ends on 31 March 2027. I need to move for my safety: a former partner has come to my door three times since August, and I obtained a protective order on 22 September, which I can share if you need it. I'll pay October's rent in full and return all keys on the 31st. Please don't give my forwarding address to anyone who asks for it. Could you confirm in writing whether you agree to the 31 October end date?
Thank you,
Dana
cases.note: Some places let tenants end a lease early with a protective order: check with a tenant advice or domestic abuse service before sending, and if you're in immediate danger, call emergency services.

cases.situation: I'm Ravi Shah, renting Apt 4 at 18 Larch Street. The building was sold in August, and the new owner, Westmere Holdings, wrote that rent now goes to them and their contact is Elena Ruiz at elena.ruiz@example.com. Clause 11 of my lease says 30 days' written notice to the landlord at the address in the lease, which is still the old owner Mr Doyle's, and I want to move out on 30 November.
cases.reply:
Dear Ms Ruiz,
I'm writing to give notice that I will be leaving 18 Larch Street, Apt 4, with my tenancy ending on Monday 30 November 2026, in line with the 30 days' written notice in clause 11 of my lease. Because the lease still names Mr Doyle's address for notices, I'm sending him a copy today as well. Could you confirm whether Westmere Holdings needs notice served anywhere else? I'll pay November's rent to Westmere as usual, return all keys on the 30th, and would like to arrange a move-out inspection that day. Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Thanks,
Ravi Shah
cases.note: After a sale, serve notice to the address the lease names and to the new owner, and check in writing who now holds the deposit.

cases.situation: I'm Aiden Walsh and I've rented Flat 6, 31 Quay Street in Cork from Mr Byrne for two years; clause 7 of the lease says 28 days' written notice, and email is fine. My mother is unwell, so I flew home to Toronto on 25 September and won't be back; I want the tenancy to end on 30 October, and I've already paid October's rent. My friend Niamh Kelly (niamh.kelly@example.com) will clear the flat, do the check-out inspection and return the keys, and Mr Byrne has my bank details on file from when I moved in.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr Byrne,
I'm writing to give notice that I'll be leaving Flat 6, 31 Quay Street, with my tenancy ending on Friday 30 October 2026, in line with the 28 days' written notice in clause 7 of our lease. My mother is unwell, so I flew home to Toronto on 25 September and won't be coming back. October's rent is already paid. My friend Niamh Kelly will clear the flat, attend the check-out inspection on the 30th and return all the keys; you can reach her at niamh.kelly@example.com. Could you return the deposit to the bank account you have on file, and confirm in writing that you've received this notice?
Thank you for two good years.
Aiden Walsh
cases.note: When you can't be there, name the person handling the handover and agree with the landlord in writing what she can sign on your behalf.

cases.situation: 我在深圳合租，住次卧，是跟二房东刘哥签的转租协议，月租2600，押一付一。协议写的是退租提前30天告知，微信通知有效。我找到了离公司近的房子，想11月30日退租。
cases.reply: 刘哥你好，正式跟你说一下：我准备退租次卧，租期到2026年11月30日（周一）结束。按我们协议里提前30天告知的约定，今天在微信上通知你。11月的房租我照常交，30日上午我们一起验房、交钥匙，验房没问题的话麻烦把2600押金退给我。你想带人看房的话，提前一天跟我说就行。收到麻烦回我一下，这段时间谢谢照顾。
cases.note: 转租要通知跟你签协议的二房东；发之前再核对一遍协议里的告知期限和方式，并截图保存这条消息。

cases.situation: 我在广州租住房东陈姨家的一个房间，她也住在这里，已经一年多了，月租1800，押金1800，没签书面合同，当初口头说好谁要走提前一个月说。我想11月30日搬走。去年我发烧那次她还给我煮过粥，想在微信上正式跟她说。
cases.reply: 陈姨，跟您正式说一声：我准备11月30日搬走，按我们当初说好的提前一个月通知您。11月的房租我照常交，30号上午把房间打扫干净、钥匙还给您，押金1800等您看过房间再退给我就好。麻烦您回个消息确认一下收到。这一年多谢谢您的照顾，尤其是我发烧那次您给我煮的粥。
cases.note: 没有书面合同时，这条微信和她的确认就是记录，记得截图保存；拿不准的规则可以先咨询当地的租房咨询机构。

cases.situation: I'm Kofi Mensah, renting Flat 4, 22 Marsh Lane from Mrs Patel on a 12-month tenancy that started on 1 May 2026. Clause 15 is a break clause: either side can end the tenancy from 31 October 2026 onwards with two months' written notice. I've bought a flat and want to leave on 31 December; rent is £1,200, due on the 1st, and I'm happy to fit around viewings.
cases.reply:
Dear Mrs Patel,
I'm writing to give notice under the break clause, clause 15 of our tenancy agreement, that I will be ending my tenancy at Flat 4, 22 Marsh Lane on Thursday 31 December 2026. This gives the two months' written notice the clause requires. I'll pay the £1,200 rent on the 1st of each month as usual through December, and I'm happy to fit around any viewings. Could we book the check-out inspection and key handover for the morning of the 31st? Please confirm in writing that you've received this notice.
Thank you for making this such an easy place to live.
Kofi Mensah
cases.note: Break clauses often carry conditions, such as rent being fully paid; read clause 15 for any before sending, and keep proof of when the notice was served.

cases.situation: I'm Helen Park and I rent out 7 Birch Close, Unit B, to Jordan and Sam on a lease ending 31 January 2027. Clause 4 says either side gives at least 60 days' written notice if they won't renew, and clause 12 says I give 24 hours' notice before viewings. Their rent has been late five times this year, so I'm not renewing; I want to email them now and also post a formal letter.
cases.reply: Dear Jordan and Sam, I'm writing to let you know that I won't be renewing the tenancy at 7 Birch Close, Unit B, when it ends on 31 January 2027. This is more than the 60 days' written notice in clause 4 of the lease, and a formal letter is also on its way by post. The main reason is that rent has been late five times this year, and I'd rather end the tenancy on clear terms than keep chasing payments. I'll give at least 24 hours' notice before any viewings, as clause 12 says, and I'm happy to work with you on an earlier move-out date if you find somewhere sooner. Could you confirm you've received this? Helen Park
cases.note: Rules on ending a tenancy vary by place and tenancy type, so check the local rules before sending; give the reason once, calmly, not as a threat.

cases.situation: 我在南京租了一套一居室，合同到2027年2月28日，第9条写提前退租要提前一个月书面通知，并付一个月租金作违约金，月租3200，邮件通知有效。我要出国读书，想11月30日退租。房东赵先生在国外，只用邮件联系，他说过钥匙可以交给小区物业。
cases.reply: 赵先生您好，我是租住您南京那套一居室的租客。按合同第9条，特此书面通知：我将于2026年11月30日提前退租。11月的房租我会照常支付，并按合同另付一个月租金3200元作为违约金。11月30日我会把全部钥匙交给小区物业，并拍下房屋现状和水电燃气表读数的照片发您邮箱。麻烦您回邮件确认收到这份通知，谢谢您。
cases.note: 按合同条款书面通知并留存邮件；房东在国外，交接靠物业和照片留证，押金事宜另行确认。

cases.situation: I'm Hana Brooks. On 1 September I gave my landlord, Mr Fenwick, notice to leave Flat 3, 60 Rowan Street on 31 October, and he confirmed it in writing. My new flat's move-in date has slipped to 14 November, and as far as I know he hasn't found a new tenant yet. Rent is £1,100 a month, and I'd offer £550 for the extra two weeks.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr Fenwick,
Thank you for confirming my notice to leave Flat 3, 60 Rowan Street on 31 October. The move-in date for my new flat has slipped to 14 November, so I'd like to ask whether I could stay on until Saturday 14 November. I'd pay £550 for the extra two weeks, and I'd do the check-out and hand back the keys that day. If you already have plans for the flat, I understand, and 31 October stands. Could you let me know by Wednesday 7 October, and if it's a yes, confirm the new end date in writing?
Kind regards,
Hana Brooks
cases.note: Staying past your notice date is a request: the original date stands until he agrees in writing. Check the lease and local rules on what an extension means for the tenancy.

cases.situation: I'm Graham, landlord of 23 Wren Street, Flat 1. My tenant Leila emailed today giving notice to leave on Monday 30 November, which fits the one month's notice in clause 6 of her lease; clause 13 says I give 24 hours' notice before viewings. Her £1,200 deposit is held in a deposit scheme. She's been a great tenant for three years, I'd gladly give her a reference, and I'd like to do the check-out at 10am on the 30th.
cases.reply: Hi Leila, thanks for your email. I confirm I've received your notice to end your tenancy at 23 Wren Street, Flat 1 on Monday 30 November, in line with clause 6 of the lease. I'd like to start viewings soon and will always give at least 24 hours' notice, as clause 13 says; are there days or times that suit you best? Could we do the check-out at 10am on the 30th, with the keys and meter readings then? Your £1,200 deposit will be returned through the deposit scheme once we've agreed any deductions, and I'll send a written breakdown either way. Thank you for three great years, and I'd be glad to give you a reference.
cases.note: Landlord receiving a valid notice: confirm the date in writing, keep viewings within the lease, and say how the deposit comes back; check the scheme's and local rules on timing.

cases.situation: I'm Ruth Ellis, landlord of 5 Mill Lane, Flat 2, rented to Omar on a fixed-term lease that ends on 31 January 2027; clause 9 says either side gives at least two months' written notice of not renewing. The building needs full rewiring, about three months of work, which can't be done with anyone living there. Omar has been a great tenant for four years, and I'd like to offer him the flat back at the same rent of £950 once the work is done, and help with references.
cases.reply:
Dear Omar,
I'm writing to let you know that I won't be renewing your tenancy at 5 Mill Lane, Flat 2, when it ends on 31 January 2027. This is more than the two months' written notice in clause 9 of the lease. The reason is that the building needs full rewiring, about three months of work, and it can't be done with anyone living there. You've been a great tenant for four years, so I'd like to offer you the flat back at the same rent of £950 once the work is done, and I'm very happy to give you references in the meantime. Could you confirm you've received this, and let me know whether you'd like to take up the offer?
Best wishes,
Ruth Ellis
cases.note: Landlord ending a tenancy for works: date and clause first, the reason in one line, a real offer to return; check local rules on ending a tenancy for renovation before sending, and put any return agreement in writing.

cases.situation: I'm Priya Desai. I've rented my aunt Meena's flat at 11 Kestrel Court, Flat 5, for three years at £700 a month, well under market. Our written agreement says one month's written notice, and rent is due on the 1st. I'm moving in with my fiancé and want to leave on 30 November; I'm worried she'll be hurt because she kept the rent low for me. I'd like to repaint the living room before I go and help her find the next tenant.
cases.reply:
Dear Aunty Meena,
I wanted you to hear this from me properly, and in writing as our agreement asks: I'm giving notice to leave 11 Kestrel Court, Flat 5, with my tenancy ending on Monday 30 November 2026, in line with the one month's written notice in our agreement. I'm moving in with my fiancé. I'll pay November's £700 on the 1st as usual, and before I go I'd like to repaint the living room and help you find the next tenant. Could you reply to confirm you've received this?
Thank you for these three years, and for keeping the rent so low for me; it made a huge difference.
With love,
Priya
cases.note: A family landlord still gets the exact date and the agreement's terms in writing; the gratitude goes at the end, not in place of the notice. Check local rules if the agreement is unclear.

cases.situation: I'm Tom Price. Since 2023 I've rented lock-up garage No. 4 behind Wexley Court from my neighbour Mrs Holt for £60 a month, paid on the 1st; our one-page agreement says either side gives one month's written notice. I've sold my car and want to end it on 30 November. I'll empty it by then and can drop the key through her door that day.
cases.reply: Dear Mrs Holt, I'm writing to give notice that I'll be ending my rental of garage No. 4 behind Wexley Court on Monday 30 November 2026, in line with the one month's written notice in our agreement. I'll pay November's £60 on the 1st as usual, have the garage emptied by the 30th, and drop the key through your door that day. Could you reply to confirm you've received this? Best wishes, Tom Price
cases.note: A small rental still gets the exact date and the agreement's terms in writing; check the agreement for how notice must be served, and keep a copy.
